requirement_text: Touch screen and button response time must not exceed 5000 milliseconds.
user_story: As a user, I want the touch screen and buttons to respond within 5000 milliseconds, so that the device feels responsive.
technical_task: Limit the response time of the touch screen and of the buttons to at most 5000 milliseconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a touch on the touch screen, when the system responds, then the response time does not exceed 5000 milliseconds.
Given a button press, when the system responds, then the response time does not exceed 5000 milliseconds.

requirement_text: Jobs by email and email-a-friend features shall be available.
user_story: As a job seeker, I want to share jobs by email and with a friend, so that others can learn about openings.
technical_task: Provide a jobs-by-email feature and an email-a-friend feature.
acceptance_criteria: Given a job listing, when the user selects the email-a-friend feature, then the job can be sent to a friend by email.
Given the jobs-by-email feature, when the user uses it, then jobs are delivered by email.
rationale: Role assumed: job seeker. Details of what each feature sends are not given.

requirement_text: The Software Quality Gate "Qualification" specifies a date in advance to every Software and / or Hardware release where the contractor gives detailed information about the qualification state of all implemented features (according feature rollout) and change requests to the client.
user_story: As a client, I want the Qualification quality gate to set a date before each software or hardware release, so that the contractor reports the qualification state to me in time.
technical_task: Set a date ahead of every software and hardware release at the Software Quality Gate "Qualification" by which the contractor reports the qualification state of implemented features and of change requests to the client.
acceptance_criteria: Given an upcoming software or hardware release, when the Qualification quality gate is planned, then a date before the release is specified.
Given the specified date, when it is reached, then the contractor gives the client detailed information about the qualification state of all implemented features and change requests.

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to open various types of accounts like savings, fixed deposit, etc.
user_story: As a bank customer, I want to open different types of accounts such as savings and fixed deposit, so that I can pick the account that suits me.
technical_task: Support opening several account types, including savings and fixed deposit.
acceptance_criteria: Given the account opening function, when the user chooses savings, then a savings account is opened.
Given the account opening function, when the user chooses fixed deposit, then a fixed deposit account is opened.
rationale: Role assumed: bank customer. "Etc." means other account types may exist but none is named.

requirement_text: Immediate diagnostics readiness of all control modules shorter than 1 second after start or switch-on ignition shall be guaranteed (at least inquiry of part number).
user_story: As a diagnostics engineer, I want all control modules ready for diagnostics in under 1 second after start or ignition switch-on, so that at least the part number can be queried right away.
technical_task: Make every control module diagnostics-ready within less than 1 second of start or ignition switch-on, allowing at least a part number inquiry.
acceptance_criteria: Given a control module, when it is started or the ignition is switched on, then it is ready for diagnostics in less than 1 second.
Given a module that has just become ready, when the part number is requested, then it can be answered.

requirement_text: User shall have an introductory conversation with ALFRED to learn about its functionalities.
user_story: As a new user, I want an introductory conversation with ALFRED, so that I learn what it can do.
technical_task: Start an introductory conversation with ALFRED that explains its functionalities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when the user starts using ALFRED, then an introductory conversation is offered.
Given the introductory conversation, when it is completed, then the user has been told about ALFRED's functionalities.

requirement_text: Messages will be sent to employers and job seekers for subscription-related matters.
user_story: As an employer or job seeker, I want to receive messages about my subscription, so that I stay informed about it.
technical_task: Send messages to employers and job seekers on subscription-related matters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a subscription-related event for an employer, when it occurs, then a message is sent to the employer.
Given a subscription-related event for a job seeker, when it occurs, then a message is sent to the job seeker.
rationale: Role assumed: employer or job seeker. Which events trigger messages is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall require users to comply with applicable laws and regulations governing data privacy, security, and intellectual property rights, including legal notices related to licensing, copyrights, trademarks, and usage restrictions in production environments.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want users required to comply with data privacy, security and intellectual property laws, so that production use stays lawful.
technical_task: Require users to comply with applicable laws on data privacy, security and intellectual property, and show the related legal notices on licensing, copyrights, trademarks and usage restrictions in production environments.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user in a production environment, when the user accesses the system, then the user is required to comply with applicable laws and regulations on data privacy, security and intellectual property rights.
Given a production environment, when legal notices are shown, then they cover licensing, copyrights, trademarks and usage restrictions.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. Which laws apply is not specified.

requirement_text: The SEP shall be able to increment to at least 1 day without rolling over.
requirement_text_raw: The SEP shall (3.3.10.15) be able to increment to at least 1 day without rolling over.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the SEP to count up to at least 1 day without rolling over, so that it can cover long runs.
technical_task: Size the SEP so that it can increment to at least 1 day without wrapping.
acceptance_criteria: Given the SEP is incrementing, when it reaches 1 day, then it has not rolled over.
Given the SEP at 1 day, when it increments further, then it continues counting.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. What the SEP counts is not stated.

requirement_text: The solution should enforce referential integrity.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should  enforce referential integrity.
user_story: As a database administrator, I want the solution to enforce referential integrity, so that records stay consistent.
technical_task: Enforce referential integrity between related records in the data store.
acceptance_criteria: Given a record that references another record, when the referenced record does not exist, then the change is rejected.
Given a referenced record, when it is removed while still referenced, then the system prevents the inconsistency.
rationale: Role assumed: database administrator. The exact handling of deletes is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The system shall utilize database indexing for performance optimization (Developer).
user_story: As a developer, I want the system to use database indexing, so that queries perform better.
technical_task: Add indexes to the database to optimize performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given the database, when it is set up, then indexes are defined for performance optimization.
Given a query on an indexed field, when it runs, then the index is used.
rationale: Role stated: developer. Which fields are indexed is not stated.

requirement_text: The user is presented with two windows the Calendar and below that the Messages page.
requirement_text_raw: The user is presented with two windows  the Calendar  and below that  the Messages page.
user_story: As a user, I want to see the Calendar with the Messages page below it, so that I can view both at once.
technical_task: Show two windows, the Calendar on top and the Messages page below it.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user opens the screen, when it is displayed, then two windows are presented.
Given the two windows, when they are shown, then the Calendar is displayed above the Messages page.

requirement_text: Information: the combustion engine can be started via the starter when NAK is open or via the electric motor with closed / sliping NAK and open B2 clutch.
rationale: The sentence describes engine starting options and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or background information about engine starting?
What must the system do when NAK is open or closed?

requirement_text: KPI (Key Performance Index) is a binding list of necessary but not sufficient acceptance criteria to be fulfilled at various development mile stones (see FBR5-8790).
rationale: The sentence defines a term and points to another item; it states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: What acceptance criteria belong to the KPI list?
Which milestones are meant and what does the referenced item define?

requirement_text: Users who give up subsidy will be displayed on the Scroll of Honor.
user_story: As a user, I want users who give up their subsidy listed on the Scroll of Honor, so that their gesture is recognised.
technical_task: Display users who give up their subsidy on the Scroll of Honor.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user gives up the subsidy, when the Scroll of Honor is displayed, then the user is listed on it.
Given a user who has not given up the subsidy, when the Scroll of Honor is displayed, then the user is not listed.

requirement_text: Candidates shall be able to choose the examination category and download the PDF containing cut off marks.
user_story: As a candidate, I want to choose the examination category and download a PDF with cut off marks, so that I know the marks required.
technical_task: Let candidates select an examination category and download the PDF of cut off marks.
acceptance_criteria: Given the examination categories, when a candidate chooses one, then it is selected.
Given a selected category, when the candidate requests the cut off marks, then a PDF containing them is downloaded.

requirement_text: System shall provide secure passwords to each user or client.
user_story: As a user, I want a secure password provided for me, so that my account is protected.
technical_task: Provide a secure password to each user or client.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user or client, when the account is created, then a secure password is provided.
Given a provided password, when it is checked, then it meets the system's security rules.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The rules for "secure" are not given.

requirement_text: System shall have a strong network of servers managed by a qualified team to handle application functionality worldwide.
clarification_questions: What measurable availability or capacity must the server network provide?
What does "strong" and "qualified team" mean in measurable terms?

requirement_text: The system shall track events related to collections, objects, components, and files.
user_story: As an archivist, I want events tracked for collections, objects, components and files, so that I can follow their history.
technical_task: Record events related to collections, objects, components and files.
acceptance_criteria: Given an event on a collection, an object, a component or a file, when it occurs, then it is tracked.
Given tracked events, when they are reviewed, then they show which item they relate to.

requirement_text: System shall display a confirmation popup after the user fills out the form and clicks the submit button, saving the information to the database for further processing.
user_story: As a user, I want a confirmation popup after I submit the form, so that I know my information was saved.
technical_task: Show a confirmation popup after the form is submitted and save the information to the database for further processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a filled-out form, when the user clicks the submit button, then a confirmation popup is displayed.
Given a submitted form, when it is processed, then the information is saved to the database.

requirement_text: Asymmetric I/O calls shall not be allowed to induce a large enough skew to force the FCPs to desynchronize.
requirement_text_raw: Asymmetric I/O calls shall (3.3.11.3) not be allowed to induce a large enough skew to force the FCPs to desynchronize.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want asymmetric I/O calls prevented from causing skew that desynchronizes the FCPs, so that the FCPs stay in sync.
technical_task: Constrain asymmetric I/O calls so that they cannot create enough skew to make the FCPs desynchronize.
acceptance_criteria: Given an asymmetric I/O call, when it executes, then it does not induce enough skew to desynchronize the FCPs.
Given the FCPs, when asymmetric I/O calls are made, then they remain synchronized.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. How much skew is "large enough" is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall provide a valid email for Google Games to execute the application on their device.
user_story: As a player, I want to supply a valid email for Google Games, so that I can run the application on my device.
technical_task: Require a valid email address for Google Games before the application can run on the device.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Google Games sign-in, when the user enters a valid email, then the application can run on the device.
Given the Google Games sign-in, when the user enters an invalid email, then the application is not run.

requirement_text: User shall be able to choose payment methods such as PayPal balance, debit or credit card, and transfer funds by entering recipient's email ID or name, and making the payment.
user_story: As a customer, I want to choose a payment method and pay by entering the recipient's email ID or name, so that I can transfer funds.
technical_task: Offer payment methods including PayPal balance, debit card and credit card, and transfer funds to a recipient identified by email ID or name.
acceptance_criteria: Given the payment options, when the user chooses a method, then PayPal balance, debit card or credit card can be selected.
Given a recipient's email ID or name, when the user makes the payment, then the funds are transferred to that recipient.

requirement_text: Teasers shall be tracked in the database the same as ideas are tracked.
user_story: As a product manager, I want teasers tracked in the database the way ideas are, so that both are handled the same.
technical_task: Store teasers in the database using the same tracking as ideas.
acceptance_criteria: Given a teaser, when it is created, then it is tracked in the database.
Given a teaser and an idea, when their tracking is compared, then the same tracking is applied.

requirement_text: The system shall store car information including make, model, year, and color.
user_story: As a dealer, I want car information stored including make, model, year and color, so that cars can be described.
technical_task: Store make, model, year and color for each car.
acceptance_criteria: Given a car, when its information is saved, then make, model, year and color are stored.
Given a stored car, when it is viewed, then its make, model, year and color are shown.

requirement_text: The system shall allow IT group members to create new spaces and modify the floor structure upon receiving an exception request from any administrative level.
user_story: As an IT group member, I want to create new spaces and modify the floor structure after an exception request from any administrative level, so that layouts can change when needed.
technical_task: Allow IT group members to create spaces and modify the floor structure when an exception request is received from any administrative level.
acceptance_criteria: Given an exception request from any administrative level, when an IT group member acts on it, then new spaces can be created.
Given an exception request from any administrative level, when an IT group member acts on it, then the floor structure can be modified.

requirement_text: User shall enable navigation between the search results.
user_story: As a user, I want to move between search results, so that I can look through them.
technical_task: Provide navigation between the search results.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of search results, when the user chooses next or previous, then the corresponding result is shown.
Given the search results, when the user selects one, then it is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The navigation controls are an interpretation.

requirement_text: After closing the contactors this time is set to zero.
rationale: The sentence is a fragment that refers to "this time" without saying which one.
clarification_questions: What "time" is set to zero and which contactors are meant?
When exactly does the reset happen?

requirement_text: You'll see that the SOAP form has been added to the list of forms for this encounter.
rationale: The sentence describes a screen to the reader and states no requirement.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a description of what the user sees?
What must the system do after the SOAP form is added?

requirement_text: The contractor shall develop a preliminary design for the FTPP Architecture.
requirement_text_raw: The contractor shall (3.1.3) develop a preliminary design for the FTPP Architecture.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the contractor to develop a preliminary design for the FTPP Architecture, so that design work can start.
technical_task: Have the contractor produce a preliminary design of the FTPP Architecture.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTPP Architecture, when the contractor completes the work, then a preliminary design exists.
Given the preliminary design, when it is delivered, then it covers the FTPP Architecture.

requirement_text: Users shall update the number of shares for each stock in their portfolio.
user_story: As an investor, I want to update the number of shares for each stock in my portfolio, so that it matches what I hold.
technical_task: Allow the number of shares of each stock in a portfolio to be updated.
acceptance_criteria: Given a stock in a portfolio, when the user enters a new number of shares, then the number of shares is updated.
Given an updated stock, when the portfolio is viewed, then the new number of shares is shown.

requirement_text: The function specific requirements for smaller parts of the field of view are described in the following chapters.
rationale: The sentence only points to other chapters.
clarification_questions: Which smaller parts of the field of view are meant?
What do the following chapters require?

requirement_text: The system shall be available and accessible to users most of the time.
rationale: "Most of the time" and "accessible" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What availability percentage and time window is required?
Which users are meant by "most of the time"?

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add the Module name for the class.
user_story: As a user, I want to add the module name for a class, so that classes are linked to their module.
technical_task: Provide a field to add the module name for a class.
acceptance_criteria: Given a class, when the user enters a module name, then it is saved for the class.
Given a class with a module name, when it is viewed, then the module name is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall assess volunteer classification weight based on experience.
user_story: As a coordinator, I want the system to weigh volunteers' classification by their experience, so that placement reflects experience.
technical_task: Calculate a volunteer classification weight from experience.
acceptance_criteria: Given a volunteer with recorded experience, when the system assesses classification, then a weight is calculated based on that experience.
Given two volunteers with different experience, when their weights are compared, then the difference reflects their experience.
rationale: Role assumed: coordinator. The weighting formula is not given.

requirement_text: Users shall be able to send text messages, pictures, videos, audio recordings, video calls, and play multiplayer games.
user_story: As a user, I want to send texts, pictures, videos, audio recordings and make video calls and play multiplayer games, so that I can communicate and play with others.
technical_task: Support sending text messages, pictures, videos and audio recordings, video calls and multiplayer games.
acceptance_criteria: Given a conversation, when the user sends a text message, a picture, a video or an audio recording, then it is sent.
Given a contact, when the user starts a video call or a multiplayer game, then it is started.

requirement_text: FTSS services shall provide an API call which provides the capability to close and delete all communication mechanisms delete all rate groups, and suspend and delete all tasks.
requirement_text_raw: FTSS services shall (3.3.15) provide an API call which provides the capability to close and delete all communication mechanisms delete all rate groups, and suspend and delete all tasks.
user_story: As a software developer, I want an FTSS API call that closes and deletes communication mechanisms, rate groups and tasks, so that I can shut everything down cleanly.
technical_task: Expose an FTSS API call that closes and deletes all communication mechanisms, deletes all rate groups, and suspends and deletes all tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given the API call is invoked, when it runs, then all communication mechanisms are closed and deleted.
Given the API call is invoked, when it runs, then all rate groups are deleted and all tasks are suspended and deleted.

requirement_text: The OBC shall be operated at different load conditions (worst case derived by the supplier upon agreement with the customer).
user_story: As a customer, I want the OBC operated at different load conditions with the worst case defined by the supplier and agreed with me, so that its behaviour is verified under load.
technical_task: Run the OBC at different load conditions including the worst case derived by the supplier and agreed with the customer.
acceptance_criteria: Given different load conditions, when the OBC is operated, then it runs under each of them.
Given the worst case derived by the supplier, when it has been agreed with the customer, then the OBC is operated under it.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The load levels are not given.

requirement_text: The patient selects the type of appointment from a pull-down menu of the existing appointment types enter the appointment date and start time (only a date or time equal or after the current date or time is allowed).
requirement_text_raw: The patient selects the type of appointment from a pull-down menu of the existing appointment types  enter the appointment date and start time (only a date or time equal or after the current date or time is allowed).
user_story: As a patient, I want to choose an appointment type from a pull-down menu and enter the appointment date and start time, so that I can book a visit.
technical_task: Show a pull-down menu of existing appointment types and accept an appointment date and start time that are not earlier than the current date or time.
acceptance_criteria: Given the pull-down menu, when the patient opens it, then the existing appointment types are listed.
Given a date and start time entered, when it is equal to or after the current date or time, then it is accepted, and otherwise it is rejected.

requirement_text: The dwell times of the measurements have to be chosen appropriately to the time constant of the tuners, amplifiers and the measurement equipment.
rationale: "Appropriately" is not measurable and no values are given.
clarification_questions: What counts as "appropriate" dwell times and what are the time constants?
Which tuners, amplifiers and measurement equipment are meant?

requirement_text: User shall be able to import metadata captured with a metadata tool into a Data Management Plan (DMP).
user_story: As a researcher, I want to import metadata captured with a metadata tool into a Data Management Plan, so that I do not retype it.
technical_task: Provide an import of metadata captured with a metadata tool into a Data Management Plan (DMP).
acceptance_criteria: Given metadata captured with a metadata tool, when the user imports it, then it is added to the Data Management Plan.
Given an imported file, when it is not valid metadata, then it is not added to the Data Management Plan.
rationale: Role assumed: researcher. The import format is not given.

requirement_text: It shall be possible for a single public identity to be associated with multiple CNDs where each association is allocated a unique private identity.
user_story: As a network operator, I want a single public identity associated with several CNDs, each with a unique private identity, so that one identity can serve many devices.
technical_task: Allow one public identity to be linked to multiple CNDs and allocate a unique private identity to each association.
acceptance_criteria: Given a public identity, when it is associated with several CNDs, then each association is allowed.
Given each association, when it is created, then a unique private identity is allocated to it.

requirement_text: Managers shall be able to edit existing tasks.
user_story: As a manager, I want to edit existing tasks, so that I can keep them up to date.
technical_task: Allow managers to edit tasks that already exist.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing task, when a manager changes it and saves, then the changes are stored.
Given an edited task, when it is viewed, then the updated values are shown.

requirement_text: The standard Save File dialog should appear next allowing you to save the generated batch file to your computer.
requirement_text_raw: The standard Save File dialog should appear next  allowing you to save the generated batch file to your computer.
user_story: As a user, I want the standard Save File dialog to appear so I can save the generated batch file to my computer, so that I keep a copy.
technical_task: Open the standard Save File dialog after the batch file is generated.
acceptance_criteria: Given a batch file has been generated, when the next step is reached, then the standard Save File dialog appears.
Given the Save File dialog, when the user confirms a location, then the batch file is saved to the computer.

requirement_text: User shall check the current status of their application using the application number.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to check my application status with the application number, so that I know where it stands.
technical_task: Provide a status lookup by application number.
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid application number, when the user submits it, then the current status of the application is shown.
Given an unknown application number, when the user submits it, then no status is shown.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add a new academic year/term to add the exam.
user_story: As an examiner, I want to add a new academic year or term when adding an exam, so that the exam belongs to the right period.
technical_task: Allow a new academic year or term to be added as part of adding an exam.
acceptance_criteria: Given the exam form, when the user adds a new academic year or term, then it is saved.
Given a saved academic year or term, when an exam is added, then it can be assigned to it.

requirement_text: System shall facilitate product purchases using valid credit card information provided by customers.
user_story: As a customer, I want to buy products with my credit card, so that I can complete purchases.
technical_task: Process product purchases using valid credit card information from the customer.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credit card information, when the customer buys a product, then the purchase is processed.
Given invalid credit card information, when the customer buys a product, then the purchase is not processed.

requirement_text: The diagnostic information window shall have a button labeled Print that when clicked will display a window listing items to print including the diagnostic information window, the history window, and both the diagnostic and history windows.
user_story: As a user, I want a Print button on the diagnostic information window that lists the items I can print, so that I can print what I need.
technical_task: Add a Print button to the diagnostic information window that opens a window listing the print options.
acceptance_criteria: Given the diagnostic information window, when the user clicks the button labeled Print, then a window with the list of items to print is displayed.
Given the print list, when it is displayed, then it offers the diagnostic information window, the history window, and both windows.

requirement_text: The utility timer shall shall be set to zero prior to the first application task running in the first minor frame of each major frame.
requirement_text_raw: The utility timer shall [SRS248] shall be set to zero prior to the first application task running in the first minor frame of each major frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the utility timer reset to zero before the first application task runs in the first minor frame of each major frame, so that timing starts from a known point.
technical_task: Reset the utility timer to zero ahead of the first application task in the first minor frame of every major frame.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new major frame, when its first minor frame begins, then the utility timer is zero before the first application task runs.
Given the first application task, when it starts, then the utility timer has already been set to zero.

requirement_text: Administrators shall be able to modify the list of agenda RSS feeds available in Dutch.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to modify the list of agenda RSS feeds available in Dutch, so that the feeds stay current.
technical_task: Allow administrators to change the list of agenda RSS feeds offered in Dutch.
acceptance_criteria: Given the list of agenda RSS feeds in Dutch, when an administrator adds or removes a feed, then the list is updated.
Given a modified list, when a user views the available feeds, then the changes are shown.
